artifact_observations.reasoning: The text inside the speech bubbles ('SKLU', 'SUDD') is nonsensical and poorly formed. While some comics use made-up languages, the letterforms are slightly distorted and inconsistent with standard typography, a common AI artifact when rendering text.

The central figure's grip on the staff/weapon is ambiguous. The hands merge with the object, and the anatomy of the fingers is indistinct and malformed. The staff itself seems to disappear into the clothing/hands without a clear physical connection.

The characters in the background (top right) blend into each other and the background red field. The boundaries between the monstrous figure and the character behind it are soft and ill-defined, suggesting fusion.
The large yellow characters at the top appear to float without a clear perspective plane relative to the rest of the scene. They look slightly warped and do not follow a consistent vanishing point.
